answer.short:
Top to bottom:

$5^{2} \times \left( y^{3} \right)^{2}$

$5y^{3} \times 5y^{3}$

$5 \times 5 \times y^{3} \times y^{3},\ \ 25y^{6}$
answer.worked:
Power of a product:

$$\begin{align*}(5y^{3})^{2}&=5^{2}\times(y^{3})^{2} \\ &=25y^{6}\end{align*}$$

Repeated multiplication:

$$\begin{align*}(5y^{3})^{2}&=5y^{3}\times5y^{3} \\ &=5\times5\times y^{3}\times y^{3} \\ &=25y^{6}\end{align*}$$
